title: Romans Bible Quiz - Chapter 8
description: Ten questions on Romans 8: life in the Spirit, children and heirs, the groaning creation, and the love nothing can separate us from.

questions.text: To whom is there now no condemnation?
questions.explanation: Romans 8:1 says there is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who walk according to the Spirit and not the flesh.

answers.text: To those who keep the whole law
To those who were circumcised
To those who are in Christ Jesus
To the rulers of this world

questions.text: From what did the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus make the writer free?
questions.explanation: Romans 8:2 says the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made him free from the law of sin and of death.

answers.text: From the authority of rulers
From hunger and thirst
From the judgment of men
From the law of sin and of death

questions.text: The mind of the flesh is death, but what is the mind of the Spirit?
questions.explanation: Romans 8:6 says the mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace.

answers.text: Life and peace
Wisdom and riches
Fear and trembling
Power and glory

questions.text: What cry comes from those who received the Spirit of adoption?
questions.explanation: Romans 8:15 says they did not receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but the Spirit of adoption, by whom they cry, “Abba! Father!”

answers.text: “Holy, holy, holy!”
“Abba! Father!”
“Lord, save us!”
“How long, O Lord?”

questions.text: If children, then what, according to the text?
questions.explanation: Romans 8:17 says that if children, then heirs: heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ, if indeed they suffer with him.

answers.text: Servants of the law and of the letter
Teachers of the law to all the nations
Heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ
Judges over the angels and the world

questions.text: Who waits with eager expectation for the children of God to be revealed?
questions.explanation: Romans 8:19 says the creation waits with eager expectation for the children of God to be revealed.

answers.text: The prophets
The assemblies of the Gentiles
The angels of heaven
The creation

questions.text: Why does the Spirit help our weaknesses, according to the text?
questions.explanation: Romans 8:26 says the Spirit helps our weaknesses because we do not know how to pray as we ought, and makes intercession with groanings which cannot be uttered.

answers.text: Because we don't know how to pray as we ought
Because we cannot read the law
Because we have no teachers
Because we are too few in number

questions.text: To what did God predestine those whom he foreknew?
questions.explanation: Romans 8:29 says that whom he foreknew, he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers.

answers.text: To rule over the nations
To be conformed to the image of his Son
To keep the ordinance of the law
To inherit the land of promise

questions.text: What does the text say God did with his own Son?
questions.explanation: Romans 8:32 says that he who did not spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, would also freely give us all things with him.

answers.text: He kept him hidden until the end
He spared him from all suffering
He delivered him up for us all
He gave him the kingdoms of the world

questions.text: What is the writer persuaded that nothing created can do?
questions.explanation: Romans 8:38-39 say he is persuaded that nothing, not even death or life or powers, will be able to separate us from God's love which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

answers.text: Silence the preaching of the Good News
Destroy the law and the prophets
Hide the glory that will be revealed
Separate us from God's love in Christ Jesus
